criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines name a specific deadline (June 15), dollar amount ($500M), scale (3 GW), and surface the missing option (dead statute) within the ~210-char see-more cutoff. Matches the 10 descriptor exactly.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.notes: Every story carries an Alaska anchor + named industry consequence: energy infrastructure (Stak 3 GW), regulatory vacuum (SB 250 death), oil production (Pikka remote ops), workforce math (HB 78 veto).

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Specifics every sentence: May 12 open, June 15 close, $500M, 1 sq mi, 3 GW, 25 miles south Dalton Hwy, 50-year lease, 2028, 14-5 Senate vote, May 16/18/21 dates, Glenfarne 2029, four named suppliers, Pikka May 18, HB 78 33 of 60.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Every claim traces to verified_findings.json with primary or dual-credible sourcing: Stak (Northern Journal + ADN), SB 250 (akleg.gov + BillTrack50), Pikka (Santos + Repsol PRs), HB 78 (ADN + APM), Glenfarne (Energy News Beat + LNG Industry).

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Reads identically to post_001.md register: analytical, position-taking, structural framing, explicit third option, capital-aware. No banned phrases, no influencer cadence.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Paragraphs 2-4 sentences. One bullet block, 3 items. Body words within 350-475. Total chars well under 3000 cap.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Real binary tension named: DNR lease terms vs. statute. No rhetorical softener, no CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Four time-bounded revisit triggers: June 15 comment window, RCA cost-allocation in lease, 2028 vs 2029 supply sequence, pension veto recruiting math.
